facts.value: This programme aims to produce graduates with a high level of competence in at least two languages combined with a specialist knowledge of the societies in which those languages are spoken.
facts.programme_association: Bachelor of Arts in Applied Languages

facts.value: The course also offers the unusual opportunity to take three languages to degree level.
facts.programme_association: Bachelor of Arts in Applied Languages

facts.value: Graduates will also possess professional expertise in an area such as Law, Marketing, Politics and International Relations, Teaching English to Speakers of Other Languages (TESOL) or Technical Communication.
facts.programme_association: Bachelor of Arts in Applied Languages
